collection_method.method: One robots GET per origin; HEAD before content GET only when needed; manual redirects with destination robots checks; requests deduplicated by URL and method; no scripts, subresources, login or challenges.
collection_method.limits: Conservatively do not follow robots redirects or request a target when robots policy is unavailable. HTTP 200 shells and barriers are not successful claim checks. Final URL is null if robots preflight blocked access or redirect traversal could not finish. Initial sandbox DNS failures were environment failures, not provider HTTP outcomes; public checks used approved network access.
collection_method.github_api: Not used: local Git history established original and current inventories; no remote issue/PR/Project mutations or claims about live contribution ownership.
collection_method.source_bytes: Temporary raw responses not retained; request hashes and lengths retained. No linked additional endpoints or scripts retrieved.
